PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'list_id';

 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR

PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_o (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_ERROR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure show_error (error_cd in VARCHAR2, add_msg in VARCHAR2 := '')
is
 text VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 usr_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 cur_form varchar2(30) := name_in('system.current_form');
 user_err_error_cd varchar2(10);
 user_err_unit_id varchar2(20);
 user_err_chapter_id varchar2(4);
 user_err_coll_date varchar2(15);
 user_err_component_prefix varchar2(20);
 user_err_product_code varchar2(20);
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
 alert_type VARCHAR2(1);

begin
 select decode(error_type,'E','Err:'||error_code,
 'M','Msg:'||error_code,
 'W','Warn:'||error_code,
 ''||error_code)||
 ': '||nvl(error,'Error missing'),
 audit_flag, error_type
 into text, temp_audit_flag, alert_type
 from valid_errors
 where error_code = error_cd;

 if alert_type = 'E' then
 al_id := Find_Alert('Error_Alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,text||add_msg ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 end if;

 if alert_type = 'W' then
 al_id := Find_Alert('WARN_Alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,text||add_msg ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 end if;

 if alert_type = 'M' then
 al_id := Find_Alert('inform_Alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,text||add_msg ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 end if;

 if temp_audit_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 copy(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS'),'GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate');
 copy(error_cd,'GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');

 user_err_error_cd := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 user_err_unit_id := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 user_err_chapter_id := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 user_err_coll_date := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 user_err_component_prefix := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 user_err_product_code := name_in('GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');

 /* insert into user_error_log_tmp
 (insert_dats, user_id, program_name, error_code,
 unit_id, chapter_id, coll_date, component_prefix,
 product_code) values
 (sysdate, usr_id, cur_form,
 user_err_error_cd, user_err_unit_id,
 user_err_chapter_id,
 user_err_coll_date,
 user_err_component_prefix,
 user_err_product_code);*/

 user_exit('user_error');
 if form_failure
 then
 message('User exit to trap user error failed');
 end if;
 copy('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 copy('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 copy('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 copy('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 copy('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in error log');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if substr(text,1,1) = 'E'
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 al_id := Find_Alert('inform_Alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,'Err:No error description for error code '||error_cd ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 al_id := Find_Alert('inform_Alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text,'Err:Too many descriptions for error code '||error_cd); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
